name: Ambush
description: Someone knows your route and is waiting on it.

name: Creditors in the dark
description: The client owes money to people who do not ask politely.

name: Hired guns
description: A rival has paid a crew to make sure you do not arrive.

name: Wreck bait
description: A distress call is bait, and the trap is already sprung.

name: Stolen cargo
description: The cargo belongs to someone else, and they want it back.

name: Seal of the holds
description: The cargo carries a dwarf hold's seal and the hold is looking for it.

name: Impounded goods
description: Customs seized the cargo, and someone quietly took it back out.

name: Insured twice
description: The cargo was reported lost and paid out, so someone needs it to stay lost.

name: The money isn't there
description: The client promised more than they can pay.

name: Someone else's job
description: The client is acting for a very different party.

name: The quiet route
description: The client knew the job was dangerous and said it wasn't.

name: Not what was said
description: The job is a different job than described.

name: Undercut
description: A rival captain bids for the same contract and offers to do it cheaper.

name: Sold twice
description: The client has promised the same job to two captains.

name: Poached
description: A faction leans on the client to hand the job to their own ship.

name: Stowaway
description: Someone is aboard who should not be, and others are looking for them.

name: Wanted charge
description: Someone connected to the job is wanted by the law.

name: Runaway debtor
description: Whoever is being moved is in debt and the lender is close.

name: The witness
description: Someone aboard saw something they shouldn't have, and powerful people want it forgotten.

name: Paid to lose you
description: The client has taken payment from your enemies.

name: Terms changed
description: The client rewrites the deal at the last moment.

name: The fall guy
description: You were hired to take the blame.

name: The sealed case
description: An unlisted sealed case turns up aboard.

name: Rim tech
description: A part of the ship has been swapped for something from beyond the firewall.

name: Borrowed luggage
description: A package you were asked to mind is not what it seemed.

name: Gate backlog
description: A gate closure or queue eats the time you had.

name: Moved up
description: The client needs it sooner than agreed.

name: Late word
description: The deadline has partly passed already, because news travels slowly.

name: Inspection detour
description: A blockade or inspection forces a stop on the way.

name: One more thing
description: The client asks you to collect something else on the way.

name: Stranded ship
description: A ship in trouble asks for help and cannot be left.

name: Old charts
description: The information you were given is out of date.

name: Wrong place
description: The location you were sent to is wrong.

name: Not so quiet
description: The target is far better defended than anyone said.

name: A better offer
description: A rival offers more to drop the job.

name: Change sides
description: A faction offers to buy the job's outcome.

name: Share the work
description: A rival proposes joining forces.

name: Your own voice
description: A ship answers your hail with your own voice.

name: Dead air
description: Interference swallows the ship for a while.

name: Odd gate
description: A gate behaves wrongly as you pass.

name: Ghost transponder
description: You pick up the transponder of a ship that is already lost.
